description: Urban Development Authority - Approval of the Development Plan for Seethwakapura Urban Council Limit.
categorisation: This gazette content deals with the approval of a development plan for the Seethawakapura Urban Council limit, which falls under land use planning and zoning changes. The notification involves urban development authority powers related to land development projects and does not primarily concern government personnel changes, structural changes, or other specialized categories like legal, commercial, or public service matters.
